description: This file defines and exports plugin SDK facades, including functions to generate module code for SDK facades, resolve source paths, and manage facade module imports. It also contains metadata for external dependencies and functions to build type maps, primarily used for code generation within a plugin system.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeModule
methods.description: Generates code for a plugin SDK facade module based on the given entry configuration and repository context, including import statements, export definitions, and facade loading functions.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeTypeMapModule
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript interface map of all plugin SDK facade types, mapping subpaths to their respective modules and types for type safety and code generation.

methods.name: listFacadeEntrySourcePaths
methods.description: Returns a unique list of source paths associated with a facade entry, for use in module resolution and code generation.

methods.name: collectRuntimeApiPreExports
methods.description: Parses a runtime API source file to gather all named exports, used for code generation and ensuring correct import/export mapping.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceTypescriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the corresponding TypeScript source file path (.ts or .tsx) for a given facade source path, handling both package and local sources.

methods.name: resolveFacadeModuleResolutionContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached TypeScript compiler context for module resolution based on project root, respecting tsconfig settings.

methods.name: normalizeFacadeSourceParts
methods.description: Parses a source path to extract directory name and artifact basename, supporting both package-based and local source paths.
